purpose: Buff reference for AOBuddy10 Soldier decision-making. The Soldier is a pure weapon profession whose ENTIRE nano kit is buffs and aggro management: reflect shields, absorb/AC shields, HP, weapon and special-attack skills, initiative, AddAllOff, evades, damage modifiers, taunts and detaunts. This file places all 177 Soldier-castable nanos from soldier-nanos.json into exactly one section each, and lists the cross-profession buffs a Soldier should ask for.

dataSources.selfAndGivesIds: AOBuddy/GameData/profiles/soldier-nanos.json (nanos.ocp OMNICELL-CONTENT pack, client 18.8.50_EP1, 177 Soldier-castable nanos). Every id/name/number/castReq marked source=local came from that file and every name was re-checked against itemnames.sql.
dataSources.childNanoEffects: The 7 'Fight (Team)' damage parents and the 18 Shadowlands 'Empowered ...' reflect parents carry only TeamCastNano/CastNano pointers. The real numbers were read directly out of E:/Funcom/OmniCell/OmniCell/Datafiles/nanos.ocp with a reader that mirrors OmniCellContentPack.ReadNanos (record = ID, Instance, ItemType, Type, flags, Attack, Defend, Stats, Actions, Events).
dataSources.selfVsOtherTargeting: Read from each effect function's Target field: Target(3) = applied to the cast target, so the nano can be put on another character; User(1)/Wearer(2) = self only. All 177 were classified this way - 100 Target(3), 56 Wearer(2), 17 User(1), 3 User+Wearer, 1 Wearer+Target. This is the local-data basis for the selfBuffs vs givesToOthers split, NOT a guess.
dataSources.statIdResolution: E:/Funcom/AOBuddy10/AOSharp.Common/GameData/Stat.cs. Used here: 27 Health; 90-97 Projectile/Melee/Energy/Chemical/Radiation/Cold/Poison/FireAC; 205-225 Reflect*AC; 276 AddAllOff; 278 ProjectileDamageModifier, 279 Melee, 280 Energy, 281 Chemical, 282 Radiation, 311 Cold, 316 Fire, 317 Poison; 475-483 MaxReflected*Dmg.
dataSources.functionTypeResolution: E:/Funcom/OmniCell/OmniCell/Libraries/Source/OmniCell.Enums/FunctionType.cs: 53002 Hit, 53012 Skill, 53045 Modify, 53051 CastNano, 53066 TeamCastNano, 53087 AreaCastNano, 53117 TauntNpc, 53162 ResistNanoStrain, 53227 AddOffProc, 53236 RemoveNanoStrain.
dataSources.crossProfAndGeneral: wiki.aodb.us Who_Buffs_What and ao-universe.com Buffing Guide. Other professions' nano ids are NOT in the Soldier extraction, so those ids are null and marked source=web.

coverage.placement: selfBuffs 65 (as 3 line-rows covering 33 reflect nanos + 32 individual rows), givesToOthers 78, tauntsAndDetaunts 26, utilityOnOthers 3, debuffs 1, notSoldierCastable 3, testOrUnused 1.
coverage.note: Every one of the 177 appears in exactly one section. Rows that summarise a whole line carry representativeId + representativeName and list every tier under 'tiers'.

selfBuffs.name: Shadowlands team reflect line (Empowered Partial Deflection Shield -> Pre-Nullity Sphere)  [id 233033 = Pre-Nullity Sphere]
selfBuffs.effect: ONE cast puts a larger reflect on the Soldier and a smaller one on the whole team. 18 ranks. At the top (Pre-Nullity Sphere, level 220) the self child gives all eight Reflect ACs +38 and all eight Max Reflected Damage caps +68; the team child gives +30 / +68.
selfBuffs.castReq: SpaceTime > 1419, MaterialCreation > 1454, Profession == 1, Level > 219, Expansion op22 2
selfBuffs.note: Strain ShadowlandReflectBase(694) is a SEPARATE nanoline from the ReflectShield(2) mirror shields, so one of these STACKS with a Total Mirror Shield or an Augmented Mirror Shield. This is the reflect you keep up; the mirror shields are the burst on top. Needs Shadowlands (Expansion bit 2). source=local

selfBuffs.name: Augmented Mirror Shield line (MK I -> MK V)  [id 273400 = Augmented Mirror Shield MK V]
selfBuffs.effect: The Soldier's biggest self-reflect: +77 to +82 to all eight Reflect ACs and +250 to +500 to all eight Max Reflected Damage caps, plus Heal Multiplier / Heal Reactivity and snare/root resist. Target(1) = SELF ONLY.
selfBuffs.castReq: MaterialCreation > 1527, SpaceTime > 1490, Profession == 1, NanoFocusLevel op22 64
selfBuffs.note: SEQUENCING, not keep-up. AO-Universe's Soldier guide states the big mirror shields lock the Soldier's nano skills for 2 minutes after use and run at most ~1:20, so you spend one per damage phase. MK IV (223185) additionally requires character level 220 AND Specialization bit 4; MK V (273400) requires NanoFocusLevel bit 64, which only a worn Soldier Nanodeck sets (see soldier-endgame.json). source=local

wantedFromOthers.effect: Raises nearly two dozen weapon skills AND all nano skills at once; the AO-Universe Buffing Guide ladder runs from 'Weak' (+3) to 'Superb' (+112). Lasts ~3 minutes and debuffs the Trader for the same time.
wantedFromOthers.note: THE buff a Soldier asks for. The weapon-skill half lets him equip a higher-QL Assault Rifle and cap Burst/Full Auto above his own skill; the nano-skill half lets him land a bigger Augmented Mirror Shield / Empowered reflect than his own Matter Creation and Time & Space allow. Matter Creation (cost 2.5) and Time & Space (cost 3.2) are the Soldier's two most expensive schools, so this is his main way past them. source=web

wantedFromOthers.buff: Essence of Behemoth line (Enforcer Str/Sta + Max Health)
wantedFromOthers.effect: Strength and Stamina together (Improved ~+54 each) plus large Max Health.
wantedFromOthers.note: Ofab Soldier armour requires Strength 900 / Stamina 1100 at QL300 and Combined Commando's requires Strength 1000 / Agility 1000 (both verified in items.ocp) - Str/Sta buffs are how a Soldier gets into that gear. source=web
A second, different nanoline source of Str/Sta for the same equip window. source=web

Nano C. Init costs 4.0 for a Soldier (the most expensive initiative he has) yet he casts a long reflect stack before every pull. An outside nano-init buff is the cheapest way to shorten that. Exact nano name/value not pinned - see _unverified. source=web(flag)

wantedFromOthers.effect: Complete Heal, heal-over-time and Max Health buffs.
wantedFromOthers.note: The Soldier has NO heal (two DrainHeal nanos only), so the reflect stack has to be paired with an outside healer in any long fight. source=web
Agility for implants, symbiants and the Agility 1000 requirement on Combined Commando's / Sharpshooter's. source=web
Sense gates Aimed Shot and high-QL implants/Artillery symbiants. source=web

wantedFromOthers.effect: Makes the target's profession read as another profession for item requirements.

givesToOthers.name: Armor buff line (Minor Combat Barrier -> Heavy Assault Absorption Shield)  [id 75401 = Heavy Assault Absorption Shield]
givesToOthers.effect: All eight ACs +21 to +530 on the cast target. 14 tiers.
givesToOthers.wantedBy: Everyone, but note the ceiling: +530 is small next to an Engineer's Assurance line (up to +5000 in the SAME nanoline 3). In a team with an Engineer or Meta-Physicist, the Soldier's AC buffs are redundant - his Phalanx (+350 all ACs, a different strain) is not.
givesToOthers.stackingTrap: All 14 share nanoline ArmorBuff(3) with every other profession's AC buff - one occupant only.

givesToOthers.name: Rubi-Ka reflect line, castable on others (Partial Deflection Shield -> Reactive Reflective Field, each with an (Extended) twin)  [id 70314 = Reactive Reflective Field]
givesToOthers.effect: All eight Reflect ACs +10 to +30 and Max Reflected Damage +1 to +49 on the cast target. 14 steps, each existing as a normal and an (Extended) version - the (Extended) one costs more nano skill and gives a slightly higher Max Reflected cap.
givesToOthers.wantedBy: Any teammate who is being hit. This - not the Soldier's own mirror shields - is the reflect a Soldier hands out, and it is the single most-requested Soldier buff in a team.
givesToOthers.stackingTrap: Nanoline ReflectShield(2), the SAME line as the Soldier's own Total Mirror Shield and Augmented Mirror Shield. Putting one of these on a Soldier overwrites his mirror shield.
givesToOthers.playfieldTrap: EVERY one of the 28 carries 'ExpansionPlayfield == 0' in its cast requirement - these are Rubi-Ka-only nanos and cannot be cast in a Shadowlands playfield. In Shadowlands use the Empowered / Resonance line (strain 694) instead, which team-casts automatically. This is read from the client data, not from a guide.

givesToOthers.name: Team damage line (Intensify Fight (Team) -> Gazump Fight (Team))  [id 223199 = Gazump Fight (Team)]
givesToOthers.effect: Seven ranks. The Soldier casts on himself and the nano TeamCastNano's a 'Fight' child onto the whole team: +12 (level 25) to +107 (level 205) to all eight damage modifiers.
givesToOthers.wantedBy: The whole team - this is the Soldier's headline raid contribution alongside the team reflect.
givesToOthers.castReq: MaterialMetamorphosis > 1649, MaterialCreation > 1380, Profession == 1, Level > 204, Expansion op22 2, Specialization op22 8
givesToOthers.stackingTrap: The parents sit in SoldierDamageBase(770) but the CHILDREN sit in strain 4 (DamageBuffs_LineA), the same line as the Soldier's own Improved ... Augmentation Cloud and the Engineer's arms/damage buffs - so a team member only gets one of them.

givesToOthers.name: Phalanx
givesToOthers.effect: TeamCastNano[162357] - puts Phalanx (162357) on the whole team: all eight ACs +350.
givesToOthers.wantedBy: The whole team. Because it is in the NOSTACKING(0) strain and not ArmorBuff(3), it does NOT collide with an Engineer's Assurance or any other profession's AC buff - which makes it the Soldier's most valuable AC give-away, not the Absorption Shield line.

selfKeepUpOrder: 1. The Shadowlands reflect (Empowered ... / Resonance Field / Pre-Nullity Sphere, ids 233012-233051 + 233033): ONE cast covers the Soldier and the team, and its strain (694) stacks with the mirror shields. This is the reflect that stays up.
2. Phalanx 29245 (team-casts 162357, all eight ACs +350) - strain NOSTACKING(0), so it collides with nothing.
3. Total Combat Survival 273398 (+1200 Max Health) if a Soldier Nanodeck is worn, otherwise Battlefield Endurance 95697 (+405).
4. The weapon buff for the gun actually held: Art of War 275027 (AR, needs Nanodeck) or Composite Heavy Artillery 269482 (six ranged skills) or Art of Peace 203119.
5. Improved Soldier Clip Junkie 273402 (Full Auto +180, needs Nanodeck) or Soldier Clip Junkie 203137 (+120).
6. Improved Total Focus 270806 (ten weapon skills +125, needs Nanodeck). Do NOT fall back to Total Focus 29255 in PvP - it costs 40 on all three evades.
7. Riot Control 29251 (Burst +110) and Full Automatic Targeting 270248 (Add All Off. +74).
9. Improved Precognition 275844 (evades +110, needs Nanodeck) when solo or in PvP.
10. The best proc the AI title level allows: Notum-Charged Grenades 302399 (AI 6+) else Fragmentation Grenades 302395 (AI 4+).

The Total Mirror Shield (70300-70309) and Augmented Mirror Shield (223229/223181/223183/223185/273400) lines are NOT keep-up buffs - they are short, nano-skill-locking cooldowns to spend on a damage phase.
nanolineStackingTraps: ReflectShield(2) holds THREE different things: the Total Mirror Shields, the Augmented Mirror Shields, and the 28 Deflection Shield / Reflective Field nanos the Soldier casts on other people. Only one occupant per character - a teammate's Reflective Field on a Soldier overwrites his mirror shield.
ShadowlandReflectBase(694) is a separate line, so an Empowered/Resonance field stacks on top of a mirror shield. That is the whole reason the Soldier's reflect stack works.
The 28 Rubi-Ka reflect nanos all carry 'ExpansionPlayfield == 0' - they cannot be cast in a Shadowlands playfield at all.

HPBuff(151) holds both Total Combat Survival (+1200, self) and the Body Boost -> Battlefield Endurance give-away line (+20 to +405). Never let the smaller one land on a Soldier running the bigger one.
AssaultRifleBuffs(212) holds Art of War (+200 AR), Art of Peace (+90), A Sergeant's Knowledge (+30) and Composite Heavy Artillery (+100 across six skills) - pick one.

DamageBuffs_LineA(4) holds the Augmentation Cloud line, the Damage Amplifier/Multiplier pairs, Helepolis of the Besieger AND the children of the 'Fight (Team)' line. At endgame cast the team Fight line and stop casting Augmentation Clouds.
MajorEvasionBuffs(144) holds Precognition (+55, on others) and Improved Precognition (+110, self).
TotalFocus(769) holds Total Focus and Improved Total Focus. InitiativeBuffs(152) holds Quickshot, Attack Booster and Offensive Steamroller. SiphonBox683(683) holds both procs.
ArmorBuff(3) is shared with every other profession's AC buff, so the Soldier's Absorption Shield line is usually redundant - Phalanx is not.
botStrategyNotes.nanodeckGate: Six of the Soldier's best nanos require NanoFocusLevel bit 64, which is set only by a worn Soldier Nanodeck (Soldier Nanodeck 270768 / Activated 280768 / Stellar 280782, all ToWield Level > 214, verified in items.ocp): Augmented Mirror Shield MK V 273400, Improved Total Focus 270806, Total Combat Survival 273398, Improved Soldier Clip Junkie 273402, Improved Ranged Energy Weapon Mastery 275905 and Art of War 275027. No amount of nano skill substitutes for the deck.
twinkPriorityForSoldier: Trader Wrangle first - it raises the weapon skills (equip the gun, cap the specials) and the nano skills (land a bigger shield) in one cast.
Str/Sta for armour: Ofab Soldier QL300 needs Strength 900 / Stamina 1100; Combined Commando's QL300 needs Strength 1000 / Agility 1000 (both from items.ocp).
Computer Literacy 1500 for the Star of Fidelity (244690) and Stellar Fidelity (281045) - a Trader trade-skill wrangle is the usual route.

Matter Creation and Time & Space are the expensive pair that gate every reflect; buff them rather than train them past what the shield you actually use needs (Augmented Mirror Shield MK V wants MC 1527 / TS 1490).

_unverified: Nano DURATIONS are not in this extraction. The 'spend, do not keep up' advice for the Total Mirror Shield / Augmented Mirror Shield lines comes from the AO-Universe Tepamina Soldier guide (75% reflect, max duration ~1:20, 2-minute nano-skill lockout), not from the client data. Verify durations in game before building a cast rotation on them.

AddOffProc's first argument (20 on Fragmentation Grenades, 25 on Notum-Charged Grenades) is read raw from the function. Whether it is a percentage chance or another unit is NOT established from the data.
TauntNpc values are raw function arguments. How a taunt value converts to hate in the live server is not established here; use them only for relative ordering.
Nano strains 12 and 255 (the two that Remedy Inhibitor resists and shortens) were not resolved to named effects - the AOSharp NanoLine enum was not cross-checked for them.

'Feelings of Mortality' / 'One Foot in the Grave' apply ResistNanoStrain against nanoline 282 (CompleteHealingLine) on a Target(3). Read literally that is an anti-heal applied to another character. The in-game intent (self-applied lockout marker vs an offensive anti-heal) is NOT established from the client data - do not build bot logic on it.

The 'Persistent' Damage Amplifier / Multiplier pair (29243 / 29244) has identical stat numbers to the plain pair (29225 / 29226) but higher cast requirements. The obvious explanation is a longer duration; durations are not in this extraction, so that is unconfirmed.
Cross-profession buff ids are null throughout - they belong to other professions and are not in the Soldier nano extraction.
The Doctor nano-init nano and the Fixer NCU/run-speed nanos a Soldier wants are named only generically; exact nano names and values were not pinned to a single source.

Who_Buffs_What does not have a 'what a Soldier wants' section, so the wantedFromOthers list is reasoned from the Soldier's own verified equip/cast requirements plus the AO-Universe Buffing Guide, not copied from a table.

NCU costs per buff are not in this extraction. Who_Buffs_What gives a few for the Soldier give-aways (Assault Rifle Mastery 16 NCU, Riot Control 39 NCU, Pistol Mastery 8 NCU, Rifle Mastery 12 NCU, the HP line 1-47 NCU); the rest are unknown.
